limitations: Existing HSE and marine-safety canonical indexes are absent; no external deduplication or bulk acceptance is certified.
Norwegian continental shelf and US area labels are geographic derivations; note derivations separately where not literal source text.
BSEE source_ref values are collector-derived date/area keys, not agency-assigned report numbers.
Five reviewed records meet 10 percent of 50 candidates only; this does not approve the pilot or bulk gate.

record_digest_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes from json.dumps({"event": event_row, "sources": source_rows}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")); standard ensure_ascii=True default; no final newline; source_rows retain packet order; rows use original unnormalised candidate JSON values including omitted fields remaining omitted.
review_scope_clarification: For all five fully reviewed records, every event/source string was read for privacy, and source summaries, publication dates, source references, status/outcome statements and association_basis were compared to the linked official source. The association_basis says published installation, country and event date; Norwegian/US country labels and some basin labels are geographic derivations from the official source location, not always literal country strings in source prose. BSEE references are explicitly collector-derived date/area identifiers. The pilot was reviewed separately and is only partial: IADC has no installation/date and relies on the issue seed association; HSE notice claims were not independently verified.
